text:
leah: quick sync  We have a coordinated rollout tonight 02:00 UTC: api v1.10.0 (introduces X-Route header), router v5.8 (header-match), runtime v2.4.0 (kv tuning). Need explicit pinwalk steps and a canary guard. Anyone object?

igor: Router change is non-breaking but adds strict-match behavior when X-Route present. We'll need router config to accept legacy (no-header) traffic during canary.

sam: Runtime v2.4.0 reduces mem pressure but changes background eviction frequency. Recommend metric watchlist: runtime.kv.eviction_latency, runtime.kv.eviction_rate, app.p95.

sara: Console: we'll add an opt-in toggle for X-Route on the feature flags page. Plan to keep it OFF until we confirm api+router stable.

leah: Proposed canary sequence: 2% -> 15% hold 15m -> 50% hold 15m -> 100%. Quiet-window enabled. Latch conditions: p95 delta > 150ms for 3m OR 5xx > 0.8% for 5m OR router route-match errors > 0.5% for 5m.

deploybot: Preflight initiated by @leah at 2025-12-02T01:10:00Z

```
preflight:
- infra status: GOOD
- canary tokens: 8
- router tests: OK (route-match stress 0.2% failures)
- runtime binary verify: OK
- api schema migration: WARN (console toggle not yet created)
```

igor: That console WARN is fine; sara to create toggle. Concern: route-match stress 0.2% is borderline. Which scenario?

deploybot: route-match failures concentrated on 1s connection spikes during heavy socket churn. See logs: https://internal/logs/route-match/1768888888

sam: Those spikes look correlated with eviction pressure in the simulator. We should pre-warm caches and set cache short-ttl during canary.

ops-oncall: Add an automated pinwalk: if latch triggers, auto-run pin sequence and send page. Manual escalation only if auto-pin fails. Also keep 15m stable hold at 50% before final.

leah: OK. I'll add pinwalk commands to run on latch. Also posting rollback pin commands here for quick copy:

```
# rollback pins
cli deploy pin --service api --version v1.9.2 --reason "rollback from v1.10.0"
cli deploy pin --service router --version v5.7.10 --reason "rollback from v5.8"
cli deploy pin --service runtime --version v2.3.4 --reason "rollback from v2.4.0"
```

sara: Toggle created: featureflag console.enable_xroute. Will not flip during canary. I'll monitor.

igor: I'll patch router config to accept header-less traffic under a compatibility rule during the early canary waves. Will post config diff.

deploybot: Note: release notes draft available: https://internal/notes/release-1768888888. Please add any consumer-impact callouts.

leah: One more ops ask: add a temporary rate limit on header-based matching to 10r/s per shard during 2% canary to minimize blast radius. Anyone opposed?

ops-oncall: +1. Also enable detailed request sampling for 100% of X-Route hits during canary.

sam: Running a final route-match run with eviction profile enabled; will update in 8m. If green, proceed with 02:00 UTC start. If not, abort and shift window.

deploybot: Quiet-window set. Paging suppressed except ops-oncall. Canary schedule locked: start 2025-12-02T02:00:00Z.

sam: route-match re-run: PASS (0/500 failures) with eviction profile. Proceeding.

leah: Thanks all. Kicking off per plan. Keep this thread for immediate notes and any quick pinwalk copies. GLHF.
